blocks.text: Ammonia ka molecule nitrogen ke lone pair ki wajah se pyramidal (meenar jaisi) shakal ka hai. Lekin jab ammonia ka nitrogen atom yeh lone pair ek H⁺ ko de kar ammonium banata hai, to yeh ion tetrahedral shakal le leta hai, jis mein chaaron bonds ki lambai (length) aur taqat (strength) barabar hoti hai (Figure 12.2). Yeh ek acid-base reaction hai: acid H⁺ deta hai aur ammonia ka lone pair use le leta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: ammonia, N jis ke oopar do nuqton ka lone pair hai aur teen H: ek baen taraf dashed (hashed) bond se, ek neeche moti wedge se aur ek daen taraf saada lakeer se. Daen: ammonium, wahi teen bonds aur chautha H seedha oopar saada lakeer se, aur N ke paas + charge.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.2: Ammonia aur ammonium ki pyramid-numa aur tetrahedral shaklein (kitab ki Figure 12.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Moti wedge wala bond aap ki taraf (kaghaz se bahar) aata hai aur dashed bond kaghaz ke peeche jata hai. Ammonia mein N ka lone pair ek H+ ko jora de deta hai (NH3 + H+ se NH4+); yeh lone pair chautha N-H bond ban jata hai, is liye ammonium ke chaaron bonds barabar hain aur shakal tetrahedral hai, jabke ammonia lone pair ki wajah se pyramidal hai.

blocks.prompt: Ammonium ion kaise banta hai aur is ki shakal ammonia se mukhtalif kyun hai (MCQ III)?
blocks.explanation: Ammonia ke nitrogen par teen bonding pairs aur ek lone pair hain, jo ek doosre ko dhakel kar pyramid banate hain. Jab acid H⁺ deta hai to lone pair us se bond bana leta hai; ab nitrogen par chaar ek jaise bonding pairs hain aur koi lone pair nahi, is liye NH₄⁺ tetrahedral hai.

items: NH₃ pyramidal hai (lone pair ki wajah se).
Lone pair H⁺ ko de kar NH₄⁺ banta hai: chaar barabar N-H bonds, tetrahedral shakal.
